text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's broken out quite a bit...
Could 
it be from eating too many sweets...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...No.
There's no way I can let my Trainer 
see me with my skin looking like this...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I must nurse myself back to health 
quickly. So that I may be worthy of being 
her Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
And also... sweets too. For that person's 
sake, just for now, I must seal them 
away—...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Troubled by skin breakouts, Still in Love 
devoted herself earnestly to improving
her 
skin condition.
